seen.body: On a second machine the committed mirror files name every issue but the local sync state (synced_event, synced_hash) is never committed, so qew status shows pending=N for every item and a plain qew sync is refused by sync_limit, though no item needs a forge write. The pull already baselines first contact without pushing. Count those items as unbaselined, not pending, keep them out of the sync_limit count, and record the newest event when baselining so the first sync clears the count.
seen.title: A fresh checkout counts every mirrored item as a pending update
